## What's Changed * fix(mac): own executable UUIDs for the CLI and built-in helper (local network access) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/433 * fix(voice): first-use cloud notice, secret filter, broker pinning, honest copy by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/423 * release: Tentacle 0.38.2 (protocol 0.28.1) — npm installs start again by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/435 * fix: P3 sweep 1 — independent files (crypto/protocol bounds, voice, guard, CI pins, installers) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/426 * fix: P3 sweep 2 — remaining review findings by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/439 * fix: keep replies visible after a turn lost in a daemon restart by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/440 * release: Tentacle 0.38.3 (protocol 0.29.0, crypto 0.2.2), Mac 0.2.75 by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/441
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/mac-v0.2.74...mac-v0.2.75

## What's Changed * feat: in-app account deletion (App Store 5.1.1(v)) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/421 * chore: remove dead code; keep test-only Mac code out of Release by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/422 * Fix Release builds (Mac/iOS): NativeTestRuntime used outside #if DEBUG by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/434
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/v0.38.1...mac-v0.2.74

## What's Changed * Sync Custom Words across account clients (silent, last write wins) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/412 * release: head 0.20.0, protocol 0.27.0, Mac 0.2.72 (74) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/415 * fix(adapters): subagents work correctly under Kraki (Codex, Copilot, Claude) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/424 * feat: show each subagent's own steps (Claude, Copilot, Codex, pi) on web, iOS and Mac by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/425 * release: Tentacle 0.38.0 (protocol 0.28.0), Mac 0.2.73 (75), iOS 0.1.25 — subagent steps by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/428
